objections.claim: The spec's edge-case bullet claims `faff config --absolute get appetite` resolves cmd to get and fires the guard identically. But cmd is not derived from parseArgs positionals — cmdConfig builds rest with its own loop that strips only --root, so rest[0] for that invocation is the literal string --absolute, CONFIG_SURFACE.subcommands["--absolute"] is undefined, the guard does not fire, and the command falls through to expected one of …. The spec's stated edge-case outcome contradicts the implementation it prescribes.
objections.evidence: Edge cases bullet Flag ordering vs the PROCEDURE step 3 and the unchanged rest-building loop in cmdConfig.
objections.predicted_consequence: a builder following the PROCEDURE verbatim fails the spec's own edge-case assertion; a tester cannot decide which of the two contradictory specified behaviours is the acceptance bar.
objections.disposition_rationale: Round-1 QA minor (the flag-ordering edge case contradicted the prescribed rest/cmd handling). Fixed in place: the spec now states the flag-after-verb form fires the guard and the flag-before-verb form falls through to 'expected one of …' unchanged (both exit 2). Round-2 re-review returned approve with all four lenses clear.
